title: Chained Onsets
text: estimate .m, .s, B.m, B.s, C.m, C.s. spread parameters optimized log scale. combined finishing time B C observed response C. Separating timing parameters can therefore difficult. Additional observations stages constraints parameters can help identify individual contributions.
code: prepared <- prepare_data(model, data_df) ctx <- make_context(model)  neg_loglik <- function(theta) {   est <- true_params   est[c("A.m", "A.s", "B.m", "B.s", "C.m", "C.s")] <- theta[c("A.m", "A.s", "B.m", "B.s", "C.m", "C.s")]   est[c("A.s", "B.s", "C.s")] <- exp(est[c("A.s", "B.s", "C.s")])   params_df <- build_param_matrix(     model,     est,     n_trials = n_trials   )   ll <- log_likelihood(ctx, prepared, params_df)   -as.numeric(ll) }  start <- c(   A.m = log(0.22),   A.s = log(0.10),   B.m = log(0.28),   B.s = log(0.10),   C.m = log(0.28),   C.s = log(0.10) )  fit <- optim(start, neg_loglik, method = "Nelder-Mead")  fit_params <- fit$par fit_params[c("A.s", "B.s", "C.s")] <- exp(fit_params[c("A.s", "B.s", "C.s")]) target <- true_params[c("A.m", "A.s", "B.m", "B.s", "C.m", "C.s")]  data.frame(   true = target,   recovered = fit_params,   miss = abs(target - fit_params) )

title: Supported Distributions
text: LBA RDM, full width uniform starting-point distribution [0, ], B gap upper end threshold. absolute threshold B + , giving uniform initial distance threshold [B, B + ]. B must non-negative, B + > 0; = 0 gives fixed starting point. distribution parameters must finite. builder also requires finite ratios mu / sigma sigma / tau exgauss, v / sv LBA, v / s (B + ) / s RDM. Every accumulator nonnegative nondecision time t0, added finishing time onset. defaults zero omitted. exgauss, mu belongs Gaussian component conditioning positive sum; t0 shifts resulting positive finishing time. Use add_trigger() assign probability accumulator absent trial. trigger probability lies [0, 1].

title: Getting Started with AccumulatR
text: workflows AccumulatR follow four steps: Define model accumulators, pools, observed responses. Finalize model finalize_model(). Work behavioral data, either simulated simulate() collected experiment. Prepare data, build model context, evaluate candidate parameter values.

text: component specifies accumulators active trial. can represent observed trial type unobserved processing mode. component column data conditions named component; omitting using NA averages components. trial belongs one component. See Working Mixtures examples.

text: onset time accumulator becomes active. accumulators start time 0, cases, extra information appears trial. AccumulatR, onset can : fixed delay, onset = 0.15 chained onset, onset = (""), meaning process starts another accumulator (case ) pool finished onset non-decision time (t0) shift response times. difference supplied: t0 belongs parameter vector, onset declared model supplied trial conditions. text: example defines basic two-choice race model two lognormal accumulators.

text: build_param_matrix() repeats named parameter vector across trials. creates one row per accumulator per trial, trial’s accumulators model order. six trials two accumulators give twelve parameter rows. par_names(model) lists accepted parameter names; set_parameters() determines values shared separate. row one trial, R observed response, rt response time.
code: pars <- c(   left.m = log(0.28), left.s = 0.16,   right.m = log(0.35), right.s = 0.18 )  param_df <- build_param_matrix(model, pars, n_trials = 6) sim <- simulate(model, param_df, seed = 123)  head(sim) ##   trials     R        rt ## 1      1  left 0.3182631 ## 2      2  left 0.3414185 ## 3      3  left 0.2883234 ## 4      4  left 0.3669476 ## 5      5  left 0.3057125 ## 6      6 right 0.2456584

text: fit model, usual pattern : prepare_data() checks arranges observations, make_context() compiles model’s response rules. Reuse objects varying parameters model. Supply one parameter block per prepared trial, matching order. log_likelihood() returns summed log-likelihood; use sum = FALSE one value per trial. Response-time observations contribute densities, result can positive. See Simple Race Model example using optim() estimate parameters.

title: Logical Rules
text: outcome rule states observed response count happened. Common cases include: one several routes able generate several processes complete absence competing event stop-like process can cancel otherwise available response logical helpers encode cases directly model definition.

title: Logical Rules
text: main helpers : first_of(x, y) finishes first x y finishes all_of(x, y) finishes x y finished none_of(x) requires x finished enclosing rule inhibit(x, y) finishes x unless y finishes strictly earlier

what: first_of(): either route can generate the response
title: Logical Rules
text: Use first_of() one several routes can generate response.
code: model_first <- race_spec() |>   add_accumulator("word_route", "lognormal") |>   add_accumulator("picture_route", "lognormal") |>   add_outcome("target_detected", first_of("word_route", "picture_route")) |>   finalize_model()  names(model_first$prep$outcomes) ## [1] "target_detected"

what: all_of(): several things must all be true
title: Logical Rules
text: Use all_of() response depends several processes complete.
code: model_all <- race_spec() |>   add_accumulator("encoding", "lognormal") |>   add_accumulator("verification", "lognormal") |>   add_outcome("confirmed_response", all_of("encoding", "verification")) |>   finalize_model()  names(model_all$prep$outcomes) ## [1] "confirmed_response"

what: none_of(): the response requires the competing event to be absent
title: Logical Rules
text: Use none_of() inside all_of() require another event occurred conjunction completes. response occurs go finishes, provided stop finished earlier.
code: model_none <- race_spec() |>   add_accumulator("go", "lognormal") |>   add_accumulator("stop", "lognormal") |>   add_outcome("respond", all_of("go", none_of("stop"))) |>   finalize_model()  names(model_none$prep$outcomes) ## [1] "respond"

what: inhibit(): the response is driven by one process and blocked by another
title: Logical Rules
text: Use inhibit() one process generate response another can block . stop cancels response finishes go.
code: model_inhibit <- race_spec() |>   add_accumulator("go", "lognormal") |>   add_accumulator("stop", "lognormal") |>   add_outcome("respond", inhibit("go", "stop")) |>   finalize_model()  names(model_inhibit$prep$outcomes) ## [1] "respond"

title: Logical Rules
text: two rules look similar: two distinct accumulators, give response rule: go completes stop. absence condition evaluated enclosing conjunction completes, entire trial. Nesting matters. all_of("", "b", none_of("stop")) checks absence b completed. all_of(inhibit("", "stop"), "b"), inhibition decided completes; later stop undo event. none_of() needs event evaluate absence. Use inside all_of() event generates response; bare none_of() outcome standalone branch first_of().
code: rule_none <- all_of("go", none_of("stop")) rule_inhibit <- inhibit("go", "stop")  c(absence_rule = rule_none$kind, inhibit_rule = rule_inhibit$kind) ## absence_rule inhibit_rule  ##        "and"      "guard"

title: Logical Rules
text: helpers can combined response depends several kinds logic . example, suppose response requires: encoding stage finish either left route right route generate choice stop event requirements completed
code: model_combo <- race_spec() |>   add_accumulator("encoding", "lognormal") |>   add_accumulator("left_route", "lognormal") |>   add_accumulator("right_route", "lognormal") |>   add_accumulator("stop", "lognormal") |>   add_outcome(     "choice",     all_of(       "encoding",       first_of("left_route", "right_route"),       none_of("stop")     )   ) |>   finalize_model()  names(model_combo$prep$outcomes) ## [1] "choice"

title: Working with Mixtures
text: sections use fast-versus-slow architecture. Response R1 comes target route response R2 comes competitor. components differ whether target route fast slow given trial.

what: Fixed mixture weights with observed components
title: Working with Mixtures
text: first example, mixture weights fixed component label observed trial. now create trial table says component trial belongs . Fixed mixtures include selected component label simulation output default. real data, retain component column trial type observed. Omit evaluate data latent mixture.
code: model_fixed <- race_spec() |>   add_accumulator("target_fast", "lognormal") |>   add_accumulator("target_slow", "lognormal") |>   add_accumulator("competitor", "lognormal") |>   add_pool("TARGET", c("target_fast", "target_slow")) |>   add_outcome("R1", "TARGET") |>   add_outcome("R2", "competitor") |>   add_component("fast", members = c("target_fast", "competitor")) |>   add_component("slow", members = c("target_slow", "competitor")) |>   set_parameters(separate = list(m = TRUE, s = TRUE)) |>   set_mixture(mode = "fixed", weights = c(fast = 0.4, slow = 0.6)) |>   finalize_model()  true_params_fixed <- c(   target_fast.m = log(0.25),   target_fast.s = 0.15,   target_slow.m = log(0.45),   target_slow.s = 0.20,   competitor.m = log(0.35),   competitor.s = 0.18 ) set.seed(123456)  n_trials_fixed <- 1200 trial_component <- sample(   c("fast", "slow"),   n_trials_fixed,   replace = TRUE,   prob = c(0.4, 0.6) ) trial_conditions <- data.frame(   trials = rep(seq_len(n_trials_fixed), each = 3L),   racer = rep(c("target_fast", "target_slow", "competitor"), n_trials_fixed),   component = rep(trial_component, each = 3L),   stringsAsFactors = FALSE )  params_df_fixed <- build_param_matrix(   model_fixed,   true_params_fixed,   n_trials = n_trials_fixed )  sim_fixed <- simulate(   model_fixed,   params_df_fixed,   trial_df = trial_conditions )  data_fixed <- sim_fixed[, c("trials", "R", "rt", "component")]  table(data_fixed$component, data_fixed$R) ##        ##         R1  R2 ##   fast 452  30 ##   slow 131 587 prepared_fixed <- prepare_data(model_fixed, data_fixed) ctx_fixed <- make_context(model_fixed)  params_df_fixed_true <- build_param_matrix(   model_fixed,   true_params_fixed,   n_trials = n_trials_fixed )  ll_fixed <- as.numeric(log_likelihood(ctx_fixed, prepared_fixed, params_df_fixed_true)) ll_fixed ## [1] 1554.949

what: Sampled mixture weights with latent components
title: Working with Mixtures
text: Now use architecture latent mixture. component observed per trial. Instead, model samples hidden component trial, p.fast controlling proportion fast trials. default, sampled mixtures expose component label output, label latent. want inspect hidden generating component, can ask explicitly. likelihood evaluation, keep sampled-mixture data form real latent-mixture data: observed response R response time rt. component omitted , likelihood marginalizes possible components. supply component column, component treated observed trials.
code: model_sampled <- race_spec() |>   add_accumulator("target_fast", "lognormal") |>   add_accumulator("target_slow", "lognormal") |>   add_accumulator("competitor", "lognormal") |>   add_pool("TARGET", c("target_fast", "target_slow")) |>   add_outcome("R1", "TARGET") |>   add_outcome("R2", "competitor") |>   add_component("fast", members = c("target_fast", "competitor")) |>   add_component("slow", members = c("target_slow", "competitor")) |>   set_parameters(separate = list(m = TRUE, s = TRUE)) |>   set_mixture(mode = "sample", reference = "slow") |>   finalize_model()  true_params_sampled <- c(   target_fast.m = log(0.25),   target_fast.s = 0.15,   target_slow.m = log(0.45),   target_slow.s = 0.20,   competitor.m = log(0.35),   competitor.s = 0.18,   p.fast = 0.35 ) set.seed(123456)  n_trials_sampled <- 1500 params_df_sampled <- build_param_matrix(   model_sampled,   true_params_sampled,   n_trials = n_trials_sampled )  sim_sampled <- simulate(model_sampled, params_df_sampled) names(sim_sampled) ## [1] "trials" "R"      "rt" sim_sampled_with_component <- simulate(   model_sampled,   params_df_sampled,   keep_component = TRUE )  table(sim_sampled_with_component$component) ##  ## fast slow  ##  523  977 data_sampled <- sim_sampled[, c("trials", "R", "rt")]  prepared_sampled <- prepare_data(model_sampled, data_sampled) ctx_sampled <- make_context(model_sampled)  params_df_sampled_true <- build_param_matrix(   model_sampled,   true_params_sampled,   n_trials = n_trials_sampled )  ll_sampled_true <- as.numeric(log_likelihood(ctx_sampled, prepared_sampled, params_df_sampled_true)) ll_sampled_true ## [1] 1177.892

title: Working with Mixtures
text: Latent weights can also estimated. keep example simple, estimate latent mixture weight p.fast, holding accumulator timing parameters fixed. Use mode = "fixed" mixture weights known mode = "sample" mixture weights estimated. Independently choice, include component column component observed trial. Otherwise omit , set NA, likelihood marginalizes components.
code: neg_loglik <- function(theta) {   est <- true_params_sampled   est["p.fast"] <- plogis(theta[["logit_p_fast"]])   params_df <- build_param_matrix(     model_sampled,     est,     n_trials = n_trials_sampled   )   ll <- log_likelihood(ctx_sampled, prepared_sampled, params_df)   -as.numeric(ll) }  start <- c(logit_p_fast = qlogis(0.60))  fit <- optim(start, neg_loglik, method = "BFGS")  fit_params <- c(p.fast = plogis(fit$par[["logit_p_fast"]])) target <- c(p.fast = true_params_sampled[["p.fast"]])  data.frame(true = target, recovered = fit_params, miss = abs(target - fit_params))

text: estimate .m, .s, B.m, B.s. lognormal standard deviations optimized log scale transformed back inside function. Ranked observations require direct accumulator pool outcomes. Chained onsets supported, logical outcome expressions, guessing, remapping, censoring, truncation . Observed response times must increase strictly response labels must distinct. code: prepared <- prepare_data(model, data_df) ctx <- make_context(model) neg_loglik <- function(theta) {   est <- true_params   est[c("A.m", "A.s", "B.m", "B.s")] <- theta[c("A.m", "A.s", "B.m", "B.s")]   est[c("A.s", "B.s")] <- exp(est[c("A.s", "B.s")])   params_df <- build_param_matrix(     model,     est,     n_trials = n_trials   )   ll <- log_likelihood(ctx, prepared, params_df)   -as.numeric(ll) }  start <- c(   A.m = log(0.24),   A.s = log(0.12),   B.m = log(0.48),   B.s = log(0.12) )  fit <- optim(start, neg_loglik, method = "Nelder-Mead")  fit_params <- fit$par fit_params[c("A.s", "B.s")] <- exp(fit_params[c("A.s", "B.s")]) target <- true_params[c("A.m", "A.s", "B.m", "B.s")]  data.frame(   true = target,   recovered = fit_params,   miss = abs(target - fit_params) )

title: Pooling Accumulators
text: estimate shared location spread three pool members, plus location spread accumulator B. spread parameters optimized log scale.
code: prepared <- prepare_data(model, data_df) ctx <- make_context(model) neg_loglik <- function(theta) {   est <- true_params   est[c("A1.m", "A2.m", "A3.m")] <- theta[["A_pool.m"]]   est[c("A1.s", "A2.s", "A3.s")] <- exp(theta[["log_A_pool.s"]])   est["B.m"] <- theta[["B.m"]]   est["B.s"] <- exp(theta[["log_B.s"]])   params_df <- build_param_matrix(     model,     est,     n_trials = n_trials   )   ll <- log_likelihood(ctx, prepared, params_df)   -as.numeric(ll) }  start <- c(   A_pool.m = log(0.24),   log_A_pool.s = log(0.12),   B.m = log(0.34),   log_B.s = log(0.12) )  fit <- optim(   start,   neg_loglik,   method = "Nelder-Mead",   control = list(maxit = 4000, reltol = 1e-9) )  fit_params <- c(   A_pool.m = fit$par[["A_pool.m"]],   A_pool.s = exp(fit$par[["log_A_pool.s"]]),   B.m = fit$par[["B.m"]],   B.s = exp(fit$par[["log_B.s"]]) ) target <- c(   A_pool.m = true_params[["A1.m"]],   A_pool.s = true_params[["A1.s"]],   B.m = true_params[["B.m"]],   B.s = true_params[["B.s"]] )  data.frame(true = target, recovered = fit_params, miss = abs(target - fit_params))

title: A Simple Race Model
text: use three accumulators. R1_A R1_B feed response R1, R2 feeds response R2. Parameters grouped default; set_parameters() call gives two drift parameters separate values shares threshold gaps, starting-point ranges, numerical values LBA drift spread RDM diffusion scale.
code: model <- race_spec() |>   add_accumulator("R1_A", "LBA") |>   add_accumulator("R1_B", "RDM") |>   add_accumulator("R2", "lognormal") |>   add_pool("R1", c("R1_A", "R1_B")) |>   add_outcome("R1", "R1") |>   add_outcome("R2", "R2") |>   set_parameters(     separate = list(v = c("R1_A", "R1_B"), m = TRUE, lognormal.s = TRUE),     share = list(       B_shared = c("R1_A.B", "R1_B.B"),       A_shared = c("R1_A.A", "R1_B.A"),       noise_shared = c("R1_A.sv", "R1_B.s")     ),     rename = c(t0 = "t0_shared")   ) |>   finalize_model()  true_params <- c(   R1_A.v = 2,   R1_B.v = 3,   B_shared = 1,   A_shared = 0.3,   noise_shared = 1,   R2.m = log(0.4),   R2.s = 0.18,   t0_shared = 0.05 )

title: A Simple Race Model
text: estimate six parameters: R1_A.v, R1_B.v, shared B, R2.m, R2.s, shared t0. RDM drift, B, R2.s, t0 estimated log scale keep positive. shared variability parameters held fixed example.
code: neg_loglik <- function(theta) {   est <- true_params   est["R1_A.v"] <- theta[["R1_A.v"]]   est["R1_B.v"] <- exp(theta[["log_R1_B.v"]])   est["B_shared"] <- exp(theta[["log_B_shared"]])   est["R2.m"] <- theta[["R2.m"]]   est["R2.s"] <- exp(theta[["log_R2.s"]])   est["t0_shared"] <- exp(theta[["log_t0_shared"]])   params_df <- build_param_matrix(     model,     est,     n_trials = n_trials   )   ll <- log_likelihood(ctx, prepared, params_df)   -as.numeric(ll) }  start <- c(   R1_A.v = 1.5,   log_R1_B.v = log(1.5),   log_B_shared = log(1.0),   R2.m = log(0.32),   log_R2.s = log(0.15),   log_t0_shared = log(0.03) )  fit <- optim(start, neg_loglik, method = "Nelder-Mead", control = list(maxit = 4000, reltol = 1e-9))  fit_params <- c(   R1_A.v = fit$par[["R1_A.v"]],   R1_B.v = exp(fit$par[["log_R1_B.v"]]),   B_shared = exp(fit$par[["log_B_shared"]]),   R2.m = fit$par[["R2.m"]],   R2.s = exp(fit$par[["log_R2.s"]]),   t0_shared = exp(fit$par[["log_t0_shared"]]) ) target <- c(   R1_A.v = true_params[["R1_A.v"]],   R1_B.v = true_params[["R1_B.v"]],   B_shared = true_params[["B_shared"]],   R2.m = true_params[["R2.m"]],   R2.s = true_params[["R2.s"]],   t0_shared = true_params[["t0_shared"]] ) data.frame(true = target, recovered = fit_params, miss = abs(target - fit_params))

code: prepared <- prepare_data(model, data_df) ctx <- make_context(model)  params_df_true <- build_param_matrix(   model,   true_params,   n_trials = n_trials )  ll_true <- as.numeric(log_likelihood(ctx, prepared, params_df_true)) ll_true ## [1] 785.4287 model_independent <- race_spec() |>   add_accumulator("go1", "lognormal") |>   add_accumulator("go2", "lognormal") |>   add_outcome("R1", "go1") |>   add_outcome("R2", "go2") |>   add_trigger("go1_trigger", members = "go1") |>   add_trigger("go2_trigger", members = "go2") |>   set_parameters(     separate = list(m = TRUE, s = TRUE),     share = list(shared_trigger = c("go1_trigger", "go2_trigger"))   ) |>   finalize_model()  independent_prepared <- prepare_data(model_independent, data_df) independent_ctx <- make_context(model_independent)  params_df_independent <- build_param_matrix(   model_independent,   true_params,   n_trials = n_trials )  ll_independent <- as.numeric(log_likelihood(   independent_ctx,   independent_prepared,   params_df_independent )) ll_independent ## [1] 513.7229 model_single_q <- race_spec() |>   add_accumulator("go1", "lognormal") |>   add_accumulator("go2", "lognormal") |>   add_outcome("R1", "go1") |>   add_outcome("R2", "go2") |>   add_trigger("go1_trigger", members = "go1") |>   finalize_model()

title: Shared Absence Triggers
text: estimate go1.m, go1.s, go2.m, go2.s, keeping trigger probability fixed parameter vector passed likelihood. Use one trigger call several accumulators share absence event. Use separate trigger calls absence draws independent; group trigger parameters set_parameters() probability.
code: neg_loglik <- function(theta) {   est <- true_params   est["go1.m"] <- theta[["go1.m"]]   est["go1.s"] <- exp(theta[["log_go1.s"]])   est["go2.m"] <- theta[["go2.m"]]   est["go2.s"] <- exp(theta[["log_go2.s"]])   params_df <- build_param_matrix(     model,     est,     n_trials = n_trials   )   ll <- log_likelihood(ctx, prepared, params_df)   -as.numeric(ll) }  start <- c(   go1.m = log(0.25),   log_go1.s = log(0.12),   go2.m = log(0.42),   log_go2.s = log(0.12) )  fit <- optim(   start,   neg_loglik,   method = "Nelder-Mead",   control = list(maxit = 4000, reltol = 1e-9) )  fit_params <- c(   go1.m = fit$par[["go1.m"]],   go1.s = exp(fit$par[["log_go1.s"]]),   go2.m = fit$par[["go2.m"]],   go2.s = exp(fit$par[["log_go2.s"]]) ) target <- true_params[c("go1.m", "go1.s", "go2.m", "go2.s")]  data.frame(true = target, recovered = fit_params, miss = abs(target - fit_params))

title: Simulation and Likelihood Tools for Evidence-Accumulation Models
text: example defines two-choice race model, simulates response-time data, evaluates likelihood data generating parameters. simulate() returns behavioral data one row per trial. simplest case means response column (R) response-time column (rt). log_likelihood() evaluates probable data set model parameters. Parameters name shared default. Use set_parameters() give accumulators separate values, par_names(model) see names accepted build_param_matrix(). parameter matrix one row per accumulator per trial; simulated data one row per trial. Prepare observations build context , reuse evaluating candidate parameter matrices model. Start Getting Started data conventions, Supported Distributions parameter definitions. function reference describes argument return value.
code: library(AccumulatR)  spec <- race_spec() |>   add_accumulator("left", "lognormal") |>   add_accumulator("right", "lognormal") |>   add_outcome("left", "left") |>   add_outcome("right", "right")  model <- finalize_model(spec)  pars <- c(   m = log(0.30),   s = 0.17,   t0 = 0 )  param_df <- build_param_matrix(model, pars, n_trials = 8) sim <- simulate(model, param_df, seed = 123) head(sim[c("trials", "R", "rt")])  prepared <- prepare_data(model, sim[c("trials", "R", "rt")]) ctx <- make_context(model) log_likelihood(ctx, prepared, param_df)

title: Prepare behavioral data for likelihood evaluation — prepare_data
text: structure Finalized model structure. data_df Data frame response labels R numeric response times rt, usually one row per trial. Labels must match model's outcomes. Optional columns specify component, onset, ranked responses (R2, rt2, ), censoring truncation; see Details. compress TRUE, collapse repeated prepared trials attach expand index mapping original trials retained trials. Use repeated observations also share parameter values. Supply parameters ok retained trials; log_likelihood() expands returned values original trial order.

title: Prepare behavioral data for likelihood evaluation — prepare_data
text: data frame class accumulatr_data, accumulator rows grouped trial ordered model. Response component labels factors model-defined levels; attributes store likelihood layout.

title: Prepare behavioral data for likelihood evaluation — prepare_data
text: Trial layout. Without racer column, row one trial. Trials numbered consecutively input order. supply accumulator-specific onsets, include trials racer columns one complete accumulator block per trial model order. Repeat trial's response component values across block. onset replaces fixed onset adds offset chained onset. Omit use model defaults. Mixtures. nonmissing component label conditions component. omitted NA label averages model's mixture probabilities. Missing observations. single-response models, R = NA rt = NA denote observed response. finite rt requires response label. known response rt = NA requires censoring code model observation rule guess map_outcome_to. Ranked responses. Supply paired columns R2/rt2, R3/rt3, . first pair must observed. Labels repeat, observed times must increase strictly. Later pairs may NA; subsequent ranks must also missing. Ranked observations support neither censoring/truncation guessing/remapping rules. Censoring truncation. LT UT define observation window. active truncation window conditions likelihood observable response \(LT \le rt \le UT\). censored trial set rt = NA use: missingness = 1 \(LT \le rt < LC\); missingness = 2 \(UC < rt \le UT\); missingness = 3 union intervals. R may retain known response NA. Uncensored trials use missingness = NA. Missing bounds default LT = LC = 0 UC = UT = Inf. bounds describe recorded response time. Times exactly LC UC remain uncensored.

title: Prepare behavioral data for likelihood evaluation — prepare_data
code: spec <- race_spec() spec <- add_accumulator(spec, "A", "lognormal") spec <- add_outcome(spec, "A_win", "A") structure <- finalize_model(spec) params_df <- build_param_matrix(   structure,   c(m = 0, s = 0.1),   n_trials = 2 ) data_df <- simulate(structure, params_df, seed = 1) prepare_data(structure, data_df) #>   trials     R        rt racer onset   component #> 1      1 A_win 0.9679031     A     0 __default__ #> 2      2 A_win 0.9198333     A     0 __default__
